query: Cut TubeForge v2.4.0 and get it published.
reason: Direct release request for a Windows desktop app in this portfolio.
expected_routing: Check for the repo release script first, confirm gates green, bump every version surface, write user-facing notes, watch CI, verify assets and checksums, test the upgrade path.

query: Write the changelog entry for the new Playlist DL version.
reason: CHANGELOG in these apps is shipped user-facing text, not a commit log.
expected_routing: Write release notes in user terms, no hashes or internal file names, and update the other version surfaces in the same change.

query: Users on 2.1.0 say the update button is greyed out.
reason: Updater defect - the most common post-release failure mode here.
expected_routing: Reproduce by installing the previous version and updating from it; check version surfaces, verification, progress streaming, installer handoff, rollback copy removal, and document the manual-install path in the notes.

query: The release workflow failed because Defender could not scan the artifact.
reason: Release-pipeline failure; scan steps should degrade gracefully rather than fail a good release.
expected_routing: Make verification cleanup retry instead of failing, keep the skipped scan visible in the log, then re-run and verify the published assets.

query: Add a new download preset to the queue settings.
reason: Feature work with no version, changelog, or publish surface involved.
expected_routing: Do not trigger; this is normal feature work.
